title: chore(dsm_sdk): gitignore generated .dsm_testdata test artifacts
body:
## What

The storage-base-dir test helpers in `dsm_sdk` write to `./.dsm_testdata*` (plus `_ble`, `_withdraw_*`, …) relative to the crate dir on every `cargo test` run. These are regenerated junk — never fixture data — and were cluttering `git status`. This ignores the whole `.dsm_testdata*/` family.

No code change; `.gitignore` only.
